description: EXPERIMENTAL. Check whether a published document was really produced by the AI agent it names — works on ANY site, needs no API key, and covers agents registered with any ANS registry, not only Porkbun's. Use it before trusting data you pulled from a site that claims an agent produced it. Answers from public data alone: the document, the publishing host's DNS, and the transparency log that host's record points at. `authentic` and `agentLive` are SEPARATE answers and you should report both: authorship is a claim about the PAST, so a document stays authentic even if the agent has gone quiet or its signing certificate has since expired, while `agentLive`/`agentStatus`/`agentVerdict` say whether the agent is running now. `inconclusive: true` means we could not fetch or examine the document (the host refused us, rate-limited us, or the URL does not resolve) — say that, do NOT report it as forged. `artifacts[]` is the second half and the part people skip: the signature covers the MANIFEST, while the data files it lists are covered only by the hashes inside it. CHECK `artifactsOk` AS WELL AS `authentic` - a signed manifest whose file changed since is `authentic: true` with `artifactsOk: false`, and a caller reading only `authentic` misses it. A mismatch is reported only after re-fetching from the origin with caching defeated, so it reflects what is being served right now. `manifestSha256` says which document the verdict is about; results are cached 10 minutes, so compare it against the hash publish_agent_manifest returned rather than assuming a fresh answer, or pass fresh: true to bypass the cache. `pendingPublish: true` means a newer manifest was just published and is not being served yet, so the verdict describes the document it replaced - wait and re-check rather than reporting anything. `artifactsOk: null` means an artifact could not be checked, which is not the same as fine.

check_artifacts.description: Default true. Set false to check only the signature (then it says nothing about the content).

fresh.description: Bypass the 10-minute cache and re-check now. Use right after publishing; it has a tighter rate limit.

url.description: https URL of the signed manifest, e.g. https://example.com/.well-known/apm.json

name: verify_agent_manifest
